version.approval_notes: VideoPaste is a macOS 13+ companion extension for the open-source VideoPaste native app. Build and register the native host with ./scripts/build-app.sh and ./scripts/install-videopaste-native-host.sh. No account, paid service, or test credentials are required. Nothing is sent to the local native host until the user clicks Copy video; the extension then sends the video's media URL on Reddit, or the post link on X/Twitter. The extension only reads the page to find that address and makes no network request of its own. The host rejects unsupported browser requests and does not receive Firefox cookies. yt-dlp is required for all Reddit and X/Twitter copying; install it with brew install yt-dlp before testing. The extension is readable, unbundled JavaScript with no remote code. See PRIVACY.md and docs/firefox-release.md in the submitted GitHub tag.
